title: System Settings

aiStatus.title: AI Status & Configuration
aiStatus.apiKeyHint: Please set the API Key for this provider in the "AI Service Key Configuration" above

modelManagementDesc: Add models supported by each provider for selection in tasks below.
configDesc: Configure AI_API_KEY or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in server environment variables, then restart the server. Without configuration: text analysis/chat will enter simulation mode, document parsing and smart recommendations will be unavailable.
mobileAIConfigDesc: Mobile apps call AI provider APIs directly, requiring your own API Key.
semanticSchedulingDesc: Automatically spread semantically similar knowledge points in review order to reduce memory interference
requestRetentionDesc: Set the probability you want to remember during review. Higher values mean more frequent reviews and stronger memory. Recommended range: 0.80 - 0.95.
maxIntervalDesc: Limit the maximum interval days for card review. Default is 36500 days (100 years).
aiProviderConfigDesc: Configure API keys and connection parameters for each AI service provider.
envConfigHint: This provider is configured via environment variables. No manual API Key setup needed.
noApiKeyHint: {{provider}} has no API Key configured. Please obtain one from the provider's website.
providerConfigLoadFailed: Failed to load AI provider config, please check network
dbUrlAndAnonKeyRequired: Supabase URL and Anon Key are required
dbNotConfiguredWarning: Database is not configured. Please configure the database connection in settings.
mainAiConfigDesc: Configure the AI service for all text-based tasks like chat, content generation, and reasoning. Just configure one.
embeddingConfigDesc: Embedding service is used for semantic search and similarity calculation. If not configured, these features will be unavailable, but other features work normally.
embeddingNotConfigured: Embedding service not configured, semantic search and similar features will be unavailable
mainAiSaveFailed: Failed to save main AI configuration
mainAiNotConfigured: Main AI not configured, please select a provider and enter API Key
databaseUrlTooltip: Find in Supabase Dashboard → Settings → Database → Connection string
autoStartBreakDesc: Automatically start break countdown after focus ends
autoStartPomodoroDesc: Automatically start focus countdown after break ends
soundEnabledDesc: Play a sound when timer ends
notificationEnabledDesc: Send browser notification when timer ends
voiceServiceTestDesc: Test whether TTS (text-to-speech) and STT (speech-to-text) services are working properly.
ttsSampleText: Hello, this is a speech synthesis test.
supportedFormats: Supports MP3, WAV, WebM, M4A, OGG
sttRecordUnsupported: Microphone recording is not supported in this environment
voiceServiceHint: Voice services are provided via Aliyun DashScope API. Ensure Aliyun is configured in AI Provider Config.
